note: Real shape, fake details: a couple's email forwarded from an iPhone (production, 2026-10-16). Apple Mail's plain text writes the marker, then quotes the original's headers and body with '> '. The quoted headers stopped the reader at the first line, so the couple's address was lost and '> Date' was read as the wedding date's field.
subject: Fwd: Wedding Photography Inquiry
text:
